title: Taiwanese Association of Oklahoma 奧克拉荷馬台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of Oklahoma (奧克拉荷馬台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter serves Taiwanese Americans residing in the state of Oklahoma.
